title: Exact closed wire schema admission reuse
question: Does exact schema admission reuse reduce repeated Draft7 and closed-reference checking across detached copies?
method: Compare ten direct checks and ten cached checks on each of three actual captured wire contracts in one isolated process based on 76f2f7f34 with the wire reuse correction. Each iteration decodes a new dictionary. Retain the initial sample and repeat after adding schema hashes to the probe output.
